description: This file defines the trait 'StatefulProcessorHandle' used in Apache Spark's Structured Streaming for managing stateful processing, including state creation, timer registration, and query info retrieval.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorHandle
classes.description: A trait representing the handle for stateful processors in Spark Structured Streaming, providing methods for state management, timers, and query info.

methods.name: getValueState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a single value state variable with optional TTL, used within the init() method of a StatefulProcessor.

methods.name: getValueState
methods.description: Scala-specific method to create or retrieve a single value state variable with implicit SQL encoder.

methods.name: getListState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a list state variable with optional TTL.

methods.name: getListState
methods.description: Scala-specific method to create or retrieve a list state variable with implicit SQL encoder.

methods.name: getMapState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a map state variable with optional TTL.

methods.name: getMapState
methods.description: Scala-specific method to create or retrieve a map state variable with implicit SQL encoders.

methods.name: getQueryInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the current streaming query.

methods.name: registerTimer
methods.description: Registers a processing/event time timer for a given expiry timestamp.

methods.name: listTimers
methods.description: Lists all timers registered for the current key.

methods.name: deleteIfExists
methods.description: Deletes and purges a state variable if it exists.
